# System Requirements (according to qt)
- (non-arm64) Windows 10 (1809 or later), Windows 11
- linux

## Install Instructions
- Download & extract the archive corresponding to your platform (not the one labelled "Source code")
- Run `VirtualClub(.exe)`
- Complete the setup screen by selecting the path to the base game's folder
- ???
- Profit

# Bug Reporting
If you encounter any bugs, please report it on https://github.com/HenrySck075/VirtualClub/issues

There's no standarized formatting for issues body text so you can say whatever\*\*, however at the VERY least you should include as much information that could help everyone else replicate on their system as possible.<br>(I don't have a complete error logger implemented though...)

## Troubleshooting
### "Could not mount the mod filesystem" on Windows
If a dialog asking you to install WinFsp doesn't appear when launching the mod, file an issue and in the meantime, download and install WinFsp manually from [here](https://winfsp.dev/rel/)
